description: Register of TWS API connection IDs used by trading tools. Each tool uses a unique ID so they can run in parallel without interfering.

1001.description: Reads portfolio-level option Greeks (delta/gamma/theta/vega) from TWS

1002.description: Reads account margin usage: NLV and excess liquidity from TWS

1004.description: Places a new order in TWS with a risk pre-check gate

1005.description: Cancels an existing open order in TWS

1006.description: Pre-trade quote, session state, and liquidity snapshot from TWS
